title: Tim Taylor shows up with experiencers Bledsoe and Charles Hall
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tim Taylor shows up with experiencers Bledsoe and Charles Hall, about unspecified at Nevada test site and Area 51, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He showed up in the life of Chris Bledsoe. He showed up with Charles Hall who said that he lived with aliens at Area 51.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a man named Tim Taylor keeps turning up in the lives of people who report contact with non-human beings. Michels says Taylor appeared in the life of Chris Bledsoe, a man who reports such encounters, and with Charles Hall, who says he lived alongside aliens at Area 51, a secret US military base in Nevada. Michels tells it because, if true, it would suggest one person is quietly following or connecting these witnesses.
